Done. The pipeline runs end-to-end with streaming-only access to DANDI:000044 (Buddy session) and produces:

- **`place_cells_analysis.py`** + **`.ipynb`** — jupytext source / notebook
- **`README.md`** — dataset, methods, key finding
- **`place_cell_metrics.csv`** — per-unit spatial info, shuffle stats, place-cell flag
- **`fig01–05.png`** — behavior+raster, population sequence, top tuning curves, bits/spike vs shuffle, spike-on-trajectory

**Key finding:** 18/48 (37.5%) putative CA1 pyramidal cells qualify as place cells (Skaggs bits/spike > 99th-pct circular-shuffle, peak ≥ 1 Hz, ≥ 50 track-running spikes), with peak rates of ~3–18 Hz and 1–3 bits/spike. Their tuning curves tile the 1.6 m linear track and form the canonical diagonal "sequence" when sorted by field position.
